alex.sales: Quick handoff 3 HeliosGov signed a 30d trial. Renewal ~60d. POC: priya@heliosgov.gov. They need E2E SSO + reliable audit webhooks. Reporting 500s and SAML attribute mismatch. Also asked for Private vs Dedicated cost diff.

maria.cs: Ill own CS. Success criteria: SSO working (email + gov_id), webhooks <1% error, no data at rest exposure concerns. Please add contact + logs.

alex.sales: Logs in ticket #12890. Payload error shows "MsgSizeExceeded". Priya prefers Private but will consider Dedicated with VPC peering if cheaper.

leah.support: I picked up #12890. Triage: proxy rejects >1MB payloads. Short fix: ask them to gzip or chunk. Long fix: raise proxy limit or stream. Attached repro steps.

sam.eng: If repro included I can scope: quick config bump (~24h), streaming impl ~48-72h. Need sample payload + exact error traces.

rory.finance: Ill draft two-option price (Private one-time + infra vs Dedicated reserved) by EOD tomorrow.

maria.cs: Owners: CS=@maria.cs, Support=@leah.support, Eng=@sam.eng, Sales=@alex.sales, Finance=@rory.finance. Next check-in 09:30 PT tomorrow. deploy-bot: ticket #12890 created, SLA 24h.
